We also offer some online appointments with our nursing team, appointment links are usually sent with the invitation to attend.

Additionally, the NHS App can be used to order prescriptions anytime, 24 hours a day throughout the week.

We hope that by offering this flexibility and using appointment links where appropriate, we can balance patient safety with convenience.

Thank you again for your valuable feedback, which helps us continue to streamline our services and ensures we are moving in the right direction.

Julie Sutcliffe
Practice Manager

Our previous system did not provide equitable access for all our patients as we were working on a ‘first come, first serve basis’. By triaging appointments, a doctor assesses patient need to enable us to direct the patient to the most appropriate service or health professional. 

I am sorry your experience of our new system was less than satisfactory.  All feedback is important as it helps us shape our services. 
 If you would like to contact me at the surgery I can investigate the concerns you have raised.   

J Sutcliffe
Practice Manager

We ask patients to complete an online request form (our reception team can complete the form on behalf of those patients who do not have access to internet services). Julie Sutcliffe
